name: General Knowledge - Animals
description: Simple quiz about animals / اختبار بسيط عن الحيوانات

questions.question: Which حيوان الغابه is known as the 'ملك of the Jungle'?
questions.explanation: الاسود تكون famous for being  تكون القاده في البريه.

questions.question: Which animal produces honey?
questions.explanation: Bees collect nectar to make honey.

questions.question: Which of these are birds that CANNOT fly? (Choose 2)
questions.question_ar: أي من هؤلاء طيور لا تستطيع الطيران؟ (اختر إجابتين)
questions.explanation: Penguins and Ostriches are birds but they cannot fly.
questions.explanation_ar: البطاريق والنعام طيور لكنها لا تستطيع الطيران.

questions.question: Select the colors found in a rainbow:
questions.question_ar: اختر الألوان الموجودة في قوس قزح:
questions.explanation: Red and Green are rainbow colors. Black and Brown are not.
questions.explanation_ar: الأحمر والأخضر من ألوان قوس قزح. الأسود والبني ليسا كذلك.

questions.question: The sun rises from the West.
questions.explanation: False. The sun rises from the East.

questions.question: Dogs bark.
questions.explanation: True. Barking is the sound dogs make.
questions.explanation_ar: صحيح. النباح هو الصوت الذي تصدره الكلاب.

questions.question: Cows eat meat.
questions.explanation: False. Cows are herbivores (they eat plants).
